**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Acknowledge Graph before lifecycle work**

When a lifecycle notification arrives, this awaits the handler before returning 202; for `reauthorizationRequired` it performs a Graph PATCH and for `missed` it can run a delta backfill, both of which can block or throw, so Microsoft Graph sees a slow/500 webhook response and may retry or pause delivery instead of getting the required acknowledgement first (see Microsoft Graph lifecycle guidance: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/change-notifications-lifecycle-events#responding-to-reauthorizationrequired-notifications). Queue or background the lifecycle work after acknowledging the POST.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Guard failure updates by the active lease**

With the new stale-lease reclaim path, two workers can process the same event after the first lease expires; if the newer worker already marks the event `done`, the older worker's later failure still runs this unconditional update and can move the completed event back to `queued`/`dead`. Include the claimed lease token/current `claimed_at` or `status='dispatched'` ownership check in the `WHERE` so stale workers cannot overwrite a newer outcome.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
